roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and maintaining rigorous infection prevention standards, ensuring the highest quality of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering continuous professional growth, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff on best practices to prevent and control infections.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about education and patient safety to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Proven experience in staff development and education.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control.
Familiarity with state and federal healthcare regulations.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 based on experience.
